semiconductor_relevance: High — Felton Technology specializes in fluid control equipment essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Felton Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. provides precision fluid control solutions, including mass flow controllers and flow meters, primarily used in the front-end processes of semiconductor manufacturing. Their products ensure process stability and are designed to meet the specific needs of various applications within the semiconductor industry.

regional_presence.China: The company is headquartered in Changzhou, Jiangsu Province, where it has significant R&D and manufacturing facilities.
